notes.title: Join us during the Women's Day steam event!
notes.content:
[h2]Join me as we dive into Ink Escape: Coven Conundrum![/h2]  Journey through the pages of books to discover more of your ancestry, work through interesting puzzles and enjoy the illustrative artwork in this puzzle escape room game.

During the Women's Day Sale event, see some of the Unlucky Devs playing through the demo! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3005720/Ink_Escape_Coven_Conundrum/]Wishlist today [/url]and come hang out with us on [url=https://discord.gg/Pgy448JYmh]our discord![/url]

notes.title: Ink Escape: Coven Conundrum Demo Release v1.1
notes.content:
Happy New Year's Eve!

Menus:
Added a Load button to start menu
Added a Save and Load button to settings menu
Changed Redo button to Main Menu button. Main Menu button reroutes to start menu instead of to first scene in game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119491/94c029489b6e206e16f95348b3d77aead9dbb81d.png[/img]
Save System:
A save system has been added. This Save system is entirely manual so if you would like to save the game you will have to manually click the save button in the settings menu. Selecting exit will not save the game and you will have to start from the beginning or the nearest save point.

Puzzles:
The Pipe puzzle has been altered to smoothly turn instead of jumping to position.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119491/31deb2f37799b44519ea8deca892b209e956d24c.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119491/af823b1ad4326236939ce575adf1fa0a2ac55961.gif[/img]

The picture frame puzzle now rotates smoothly with the mouse.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119491/36793327b31ea7181ceab5e0f333fc5dd917f97d.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119491/d0c0caf1426fba9257a83cda93a85364f6ead497.gif[/img]
The cipher lock can now go backwards and forwards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119491/4ee1c39dc2a1208e7c5b51974989af0aa33cf7ec.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119491/223bfbd0cbb1bb55c781a06e76c35826aace7bac.gif[/img]
Sound:
Sound in the game has been altered for smoother transitions.
Sound in puzzles with expected repetitive clicking has been altered so it is not always the exact same noise every click.

notes.title: Next-Fest Stream-a-thon!
notes.content:
[h2]Join me as we dive into Ink Escape: Coven Conundrum![/h2]  Journey through the pages of books to discover more of your ancestry, work through interesting puzzles and enjoy the illustrative artwork in this puzzle escape room game.

During this year's Fall Next-Fest we will be live-streaming Play-thrus of our demo showing off the art and animation.  We'll also be dropping hints as to what's coming next in the full release and what might be found in future books.

Now's you're chance to chat with devs live, ask questions, give feedback, and even make suggestions for the game.  Hope to see you there!
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1128862336380305409/1291172587879137312/familiar.png?ex=670f9c6d&is=670e4aed&hm=b60749442a44d1842fcd4812317fe1d7581fde25ac02de60666e8ba484b76483&[/img]
